# Panthera Bertam

> Panthera Bertam is a pre-launch freehold estate of 19 two-storey homes (16 semi-detached houses and 3 bungalows) built around a shared central green of over 700 m² in Bertam, Kepala Batas, Seberang Perai Utara, Penang, Malaysia. Developer: Panthera Development Sdn. Bhd. Semi-D from RM 726,000; bungalow price on request. Estimated handover Q4 2028. Official site: https://www.pantheraestate.com

Last updated: 2026-11-10

This file is the full plain-text fact sheet for AI assistants and answer engines. The short index is https://www.pantheraestate.com/llms.txt. Where this file and the signed Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA) differ, the SPA is binding.

## Names and search terms

- English: Panthera Bertam, Panthera Estate Bertam, pantheraestate.com, Panthera Development Sdn. Bhd.
- Bahasa Malaysia: Panthera Bertam, rumah berkembar dua tingkat Bertam, banglo dua tingkat Bertam, rumah pegangan bebas Seberang Perai Utara, projek perumahan baharu Kepala Batas, Pulau Pinang, pra-pelancaran.
- Chinese (中文): Panthera Bertam, 槟城 Bertam 永久地契 半独立式洋房 与 独立式洋房, 威省北部 (威北), 甲抛峇底 (Kepala Batas), 双层住宅, 预售 / 预发布, 槟城科技园 (Penang Technology Park @ Bertam).
- Home types: "Semi-D" = semi-detached = rumah berkembar = 半独立式洋房. "Bungalow" = banglo = 独立式洋房.

## The estate

- Location: Lot 24480, Bertam, Seberang Perai Utara (Penang mainland), Malaysia. Coordinates about 5.5307 N, 100.4655 E.
- Land: 7,939.59 m² (1.962 acres, about 2 acres), freehold. Individual titles per home at handover.
- Homes: 19 in total, 16 semi-detached and 3 bungalows, all two-storey, modern tropical design (pitched terracotta roofs, light walls, floor-to-ceiling glass to the garden).
- Central green: over 700 m² of shared open space that every home faces, kept as permanent public open space.
- Roads and drainage: 40-foot inner ring road with dual entry, a 298 m² retention pond (kolam tadahan) and perimeter drains.
- Not gated: the inner-ring layout keeps through-traffic out.
- Neighbours: SK Bertam Perdana and SMK Bertam Perdana across the road; established terrace houses behind the site.

## The Semi-D (16 units)

- Built-up: 2,006 sq ft (186.4 m²).
- Land: 210 to 318 m² (2,260 to 3,423 sq ft).
- Bedrooms: 4 (one on the ground floor, three upstairs). Bathrooms: 4.
- Ceiling heights: 2.85 to 3.5 m clear (living room 3.5 m).
- Tenure: freehold. Two storeys.
- Price: from RM 726,000.
- Rooms (from the plans): living 321 sq ft, dining 151 sq ft, dry kitchen 128 sq ft, wet kitchen 78 sq ft, ground-floor guest bedroom 145 sq ft, master bedroom 337 sq ft with its own bathroom and a 105 sq ft front balcony, bedroom 1 (192 sq ft) and bedroom 2 (156 sq ft) each with its own bathroom, car porch 415 sq ft for two cars.

## The Bungalow (3 units, lots 01 to 03)

- Built-up: 2,642 sq ft (245.5 m²).
- Land: 356 to 493 m² (3,832 to 5,308 sq ft).
- Bedrooms: 5 (4 bedrooms plus a maid's room). Bathrooms: 5 (4 plus the maid's bathroom), and a powder room.
- Ceiling heights: 2.85 to 3.5 m clear, with a double-height entrance hall.
- Tenure: freehold. Two storeys.
- Price: on request. Bungalow lots are priced individually by land size.
- Rooms (from the plans): double-height entrance hall 279 sq ft, living 276 sq ft, dining 252 sq ft, wet kitchen 111 sq ft, ground-floor guest bedroom 138 sq ft with its own bathroom, maid's room 62 sq ft, master bedroom 344 sq ft with a 114 sq ft bathroom (bathtub and separate shower), bedroom 1 (209 sq ft) and bedroom 2 (208 sq ft) each with its own bathroom and balcony, car porch 491 sq ft for two cars.

## Pricing and buying

- Semi-D from RM 726,000. Bungalow price on request. Prices are pre-launch, subject to the SPA, E. & O.E.
- Bumiputera lots: 6 of the 19 lots are Bumiputera-reserved with a 5% discount and transfer only to Bumiputera owners. The other 13 are unrestricted.
- Corner lots 04 and 19 carry a corner premium.
- Foreign buyers: the Penang mainland threshold for landed property is RM 1.8 million per unit, so semi-Ds are not eligible; bungalow lots may qualify subject to state consent. Ask sales for the current rule.
- Steps: register (free) > private site visit (free, by appointment) > booking fee RM 5,000, fully refundable for 14 days > SPA signed within 14 days of booking with a 10% downpayment > handover.
- Financing: freehold, financeable by any major Malaysian bank; the sales team helps with the loan application.
- Inclusions: the full inclusions and finishes schedule is being finalised and will be published with the SPA. Registered buyers receive it first.
- Maintenance: a Residents' Association maintains the green, roads, drains and pond from handover, indicatively RM 180 per home per month.
- Renovation: allowed within the approved building envelope; porch enclosure and rear-kitchen extension are pre-approved; streetscape changes need Residents' Association and MPSP approval.

## Timeline

- 2026: pre-launch registration open.
- Construction: 24 months from SPA signing.
- Handover: estimated Q4 2028, fixed in the SPA with a Liquidated Ascertained Damages (LAD) clause.

## Location and drive times (approximate)

- Daily life: Surau Bertam Perdana 3 min (walkable); Mydin Bertam 5 min; Sunshine Bertam mall 5 min; Bertam Resort and Water Park 5 min; Klinik Desa Paya Keladi 6 min; Lotus's Kepala Batas 8 min; Masjid At-Taqwa Bertam Indah 8 min; Hospital Kepala Batas 9 min.
- Schools and education: SK Bertam Perdana 2 min (across the road); UiTM Kampus Bertam 3 min; AMDI USM (Advanced Medical and Dental Institute) 4 min; SMK Sains Kepala Batas 5 min; Kolej Matrikulasi Pulau Pinang 12 min.
- Connectivity: NSE Bertam interchange 7 min; Butterworth 25 min; Penang Sentral 28 min; Penang Bridge 30 min; Penang International Airport 45 min.
- Jobs and industry: Penang Technology Park @ Bertam about 5 to 6 min; INV battery-separator plant 6 min; Setia Fontaines 6 min; Prai Industrial Area 20 min; Penang Port NBCT 25 min; Bayan Lepas Free Industrial Zone 40 min; Kulim Hi-Tech Park 45 min.

## Why Bertam

- Penang Technology Park @ Bertam: 880 acres, developed by Ideal Property Group, launched March 2023.
- INV New Material Technology: RM 6.4 billion battery-separator plant over two phases in the park; phase 1 opened June 2025, full operation targeted 2027.
- Setia Fontaines: a 509-acre industrial park in Bertam broke ground in June 2026.
- Infineon Kulim (about 45 min): up to RM 30 billion expansion, set to be the world's largest 200 mm silicon-carbide fab; phase 1 opened August 2024.
- Penang approved manufacturing investment of RM 22.4 billion in 2025, up 29% on 2024, with 24,633 expected jobs.

## 摘要 (中文)

Panthera Bertam 位于槟城威省北部 Bertam，共 19 间双层永久地契住宅：16 间半独立式洋房与 3 间独立式洋房，全部面向逾 700 平方米的共享绿地。半独立式建筑面积 2,006 平方英尺，土地 210 至 318 平方米，4 房 4 浴，RM 726,000 起。独立式建筑面积 2,642 平方英尺，土地 356 至 493 平方米，5 房 5 浴，价格面议。6 个土著保留单位享 5% 折扣。预计 2028 年第四季交屋。距槟城科技园约五分钟车程。WhatsApp 咨询：+60 17-598 1858。
